facebook.caption: Walked past the resort strip. Found Ong Lang beach instead. No beach clubs. No hawkers every 10 meters. Just long stretches of sand and water that actually looks that color. 4.1 stars across 745 reviews and it still feels like nobody told the crowds. Pack a bag, hire a scooter, head north. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Scooter north of the resort strip and this is what you find. Ong Lang beach. 745 people rated it. Somehow still this quiet. Watch till the end.
